# Marshall Radio Telemetry Identity

> Brand guidelines, tokens and logo files for Marshall Radio Telemetry (marshallradio.com), maker of GPS and radio telemetry tracking and recovery equipment for falconry, parrots and sporting dogs..

Agent-readable brand guidance is plain Markdown:

- [AGENTS](/AGENTS.md): rules that apply to every task, and the topic index
- [DESIGN.md](/DESIGN.md): tokens and component specs in the DESIGN.md format
- [brand.json](/brand.json): the same tokens and names as JSON
- [Naming and brand architecture](/agents/naming.md): company, product-line and product names; URLs and file names.
- [Approved facts](/agents/facts.md): the only facts, claims and contact details agents may state.
- [Logo](/agents/logo.md): vector logo files and rules (clear space, minimum size, versions, don'ts).
- [Color](/agents/color.md): palette: M Blue, M Red, Khaki Grey, Light Grey, Black, 20% tints.
- [Typography](/agents/typography.md): Matter (Displaay), (Matter Regular (400) and Matter Bold (700)); type scale.
- [Design tokens](/agents/tokens.md): CSS custom properties, Tailwind.
- [Imagery and the arcs](/agents/imagery.md): photography and the graphic device.
- [Voice](/agents/voice.md): principles, tone by channel, editorial rules, word list.
- [Regions and languages](/agents/regions.md): regional sites and non-English content.
- [Asset paths](/agents/assets.md): exact file paths.
